f16abs2_snan_check: The f16abs2 AND refolds into llvm.fabs.f16 and selects fabs.h (= fsgnjx.h), which the RISC-V spec defines as a non-arithmetic sign injection: it neither canonicalizes NaNs nor raises exceptions. Measured on GVSoC with logs/20-F041-rev2/hs.c driving k3h.c's n0/n4/n6, where objdump confirms fabs.h is in each. Inputs 0x7c01 (sNaN), 0xfc01, 0xfd55 (sNaN with payload), 0x7e00, 0x8001, 0xfc00, 0x8000, 0xbc00 give 0x7c01 0x7c01 0x7d55 0x7e00 0x0001 0x7c00 0x0000 0x3c00 at clang O1/O2/Oz, identical to GAP9 GCC -O2 (vfabs.h) and to the AND reference. snan.c + k4.c (f16 pair loops, which select p.bclr, and bf16 lane shapes) also match GAP9 GCC bit for bit at O0..Oz.
